title: C-melody saxes and Willis Young's nephews Sport and Boot
summary: Phillips says only Mr. Young played the C-melodys; his older nephews Sport and Boot, a trombonist, had played in his uncle's band on the Heck, Beck and Wallace circus.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: When the tape went over, you were talking about the C-melody sax. You said he had two C-melody sax in the Young group, but nobody played them until vaudeville.
That's right.
Did Lester play them in vaudeville?
No, he played tenor.
Who was playing the C-melody?
He was, and... Nobody but him. Mr. Young.
Oh, Mr. Young, but not Lester.
No. Lester played tenor, Lee played alto and Arnold played alto, and Mr. Young played baritone.
In the vaudeville show.
Yeah. But he had these two C-melodys, in case... See, he had a nephew once who was a good saxophone player, too.
Who was that?
Mr. Young.
What was the nephew's name?
I never met him. They called his Sport. But I never met him. But they say he was, at that time, a good saxophone player. He played C-melody. So that's why he had those...
[SPELLS C-MELODY] You were talking about his nephew.
Yeah, and he played good horn, but he left and went back to Hammond, Louisiana. Originally, that's where
Phillips - 87
Mr. Young is from -- Hammond, Louisiana.
So Sport must have been Lester's cousin.

He was. He had two of them. He had another one played, they called him Boot... See, I never met them. They used to talk about them all the time. He was a helluva trombone player. That was Sport's brother. So they was with the old man for a long time until they got tired of traveling around on the shows. They was on the Heck and Beck and Wallace circus. That was three guys on that circus -- Heck, Beck and Wallace.
And you say Boot and Sport were part of that?
They played in the band, see. Their uncle had the band on the show.
Their uncle.
Yeah.
You mean Willis Young?
Yeah.
When was this in relation to Lester? Did he have anything to do with it?
Oh, no. That was before Lester's time. They were much holder than Lester.
Oh, I see. These cousins were older.
Yeah, much older than Lester.
